title: Vallée's 260,000-case Capela database

tellings.quote: 260,000 cases, like I said, the Capela database that he made.

plain: A researcher identified only as Jason, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that Jacques Vallée, a computer scientist who has studied UFO reports for decades, built a collection of reports he calls the Capela database. Jason says it holds about 260,000 cases. If so, it would be one of the largest records of UFO sightings anyone has gathered.
